items.html: *And now let us explain the order of the clothing of the Partzufim one within another. For in Atzilut we have already explained that all the Partzufim are complete and whole. And behold, the three highest of Atik remain revealed, without clothing, for AA cannot clothe him because of the great purity and fineness of the head of Atik. And indeed, the seven lower of Atik are clothed within AA, in all its ten Sefirot.
